note: Generation recipes for the shared SFX library. SOURCE OF TRUTH for what the library should contain: one entry per reusable, generically-named sound, organized by FUNCTION (motion / tension / emphasis / snap) plus channel extras. tools/gen_sfx.py reads this, generates any MISSING clip via the ElevenLabs sound-generation API, loudness-normalizes it and writes catalog.json. Taste: calm, premium, felt-not-heard, always under the voice. Prompt one sound per entry (the ElevenLabs SFX prompting FAQ advises against multi-sound sequences).

sounds.prompt: A short, soft air whoosh for a scene transition. Smooth gentle movement of air in the low-mids, premium and restrained, not aggressive or bright. Quick and clean, no metallic ring, no music.
A soft, drawn-out wind whoosh for a gliding transition. Smooth airy sustained movement of air, gentle and premium. Longer and softer than a quick whoosh, no aggression, no metallic ring, no music.
A single soft, rounded pop for a UI element or number appearing on screen. Clean, short, pleasant, slightly woody, not cartoonish, no reverb tail, no music.
A soft, deep, rounded impact for a key moment landing on screen. Low thud with a short warm tail, cinematic but restrained, no trailer slam, no distortion, no music.
A single soft, premium UI click, like a well-made app button. Short, clean, slightly muted, satisfying, no echo, no music.
A short, gentle upward riser building light anticipation over about one and a half seconds. Smooth airy swell, calm and premium, resolving softly at the top. Not dramatic, no big hit, no cymbal.
A single coin dropping onto a wooden table and settling quickly. Clean, close, small, realistic, one bounce, no jingle of many coins, no music.
A muted, modern cash register confirmation: one soft mechanical clunk with a faint short bell. Understated and clean, not a loud ka-ching, no music.
A single soft clock tick. Short, dry, wooden, clean, no reverb, no music.
A soft, warm two-note chime for a small reward or payoff moment. Gentle bell tone, short decay, pleasant and understated, not a game jingle, no music.
A short, soft, low error buzz for something being crossed out or rejected. Muted, rounded, not harsh, not a game-show buzzer, no music.
A single quick page flip of a paper sheet. Close, crisp, light, realistic, no music.
A slow, warm, airy tonal swell rising gently over two seconds and dissolving. Soft and cinematic, for a quiet twist or realization, no percussion, no hit at the end.
One tiny mechanical tick, like a single step of an odometer or a precise rotary dial. Very short, dry, clean, no reverb, no music.
A single footstep of a small wooden toy block character landing on a hard floor. Short, hollow, light, slightly cute, clean, no music.
A deep, soft, rounded sub impact with a slow warm tail for the final payoff landing. Low, cinematic, restrained, no distortion, no trailer boom, no music.
A single rubber stamp hitting paper on a desk: short dry thud with a faint paper slap. Close, clean, satisfying, no echo, no music.
A soft, even mechanical ticking, like a quiet clock or a spinning prize wheel slowing down, for about two seconds. Dry, muted, steady, no bell, no music.
A single soft UI toggle switching on: a small rounded click with a tiny upward tonal blip. Clean, premium, satisfying, no reverb, no music.
A soft reversed air whoosh that builds and stops abruptly, like air being drawn back in for a rewind or dissolve. Smooth, low-mid, premium, no metallic ring, no music.
